dka.text: The Church of Avacyn arose when Sorin saw vampires dwindling the human villages and created the angel Avacyn to protect Innistrad.

After Avacyn disappears and the wards weaken, the Church recruits new holy warriors, while Mikaeus makes the few priests who witnessed the tragedy swear to secrecy and the Church conceals Avacyn's fate.

Vampires of Stensia take up residence among humans and kill cathars as the Church's authority fails, and Liliana Vess plans to confront the Church's highest echelons after learning Griselbrand is on Innistrad.
